Agent Name: Planner

Reason for Mistake: The Planner made an error by incorrectly interpreting "Dilan 1991" as being released in 1991 based solely on the title and without adequately confirming the release year against reliable sources. This mistake neglects the actual release date of February 28, 2019, provided clearly by both IMDb and other sources. The Planner failed to perform a proper comparison between the provided dates of "Celine: Through The Eyes Of The World" (2010) and "Dilan 1991" (2019), leading to an incorrect conclusion that "Dilan 1991" was released in 1991 instead of 2019. This error stems from over-reliance on superficial title cues rather than cross-validating all collected data and ensuring consistency.
